messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: HorizonTech discovery - business outcomes & procurement path

Thanks again Rajiv and Sara for your time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment moving into the exec briefing and procurement loop.

Key pain points you confirmed
- Burst latency spikes on peak search queries (95th percentile > 1.2s) impacting UX and conversions
- High and unpredictable token costs from current hosted provider; limited batching/caching options
- Data residency + on-prem connectors needed for PII-sensitive logs and customer records

Goals (business outcomes)
- Predictable interactive latency (95th < 200-250ms) for our search flows
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~40-60% through batching/caching/quantization without losing quality
- Maintain data control (VPC/on-prem option) and pass security/compliance review for production

Procurement / timeline items you called out
- Security review (Sara) to confirm SOC 2 artifacts + KMS/SSO requirements - target: complete by 2027-04-01
- Procurement (procurement@horizontech.com) will own contract/PO; expectation to review SOW and pricing week of 3/22
- Exec briefing: proposed 3/22 or 3/24 - suggested audience: Rajiv (VP Eng), Sara (Head of Security), procurement lead, and your CTO

Risks / open items
- If SOC 2 artifacts or KMS requirements take longer, that could push the procurement window by 2-3 weeks
- If your on-prem connector requires a custom network topology, engineering effort estimate will be needed

Next steps (action owners)
- Laura (me): send Mutual Action Plan (attached) + draft SOW and pricing sheet; propose exec briefing times (attached booking link) - by EOD today
- Rajiv / Sara: confirm exec availability and any additional security artifacts you need for review - by 3/18
- Procurement: share PO/contract template and preferred redline process - by 3/22

Attachments: HorizonTech-MAP-v1.pdf, HorizonTech-SOW-draft.docx, HorizonTech-pricing-sheet.xlsx

Thanks - happy to jump on a short call if anything above needs adjustment.

--
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

I’ve attached a short pricing sheet and the MAP/SOW draft to make it easier for procurement/legal to start the review.

2) Redwood platform demo: latency guarantees, routing & fallback, cost controls - 15m (Aditya to lead)
3) Security & compliance overview - 10m (Marissa to cover SOC 2, KMS, data residency options)
4) Procurement and next steps (Laura) - 5-10m

Please use this booking link to lock the 3/22 10am PT slot: https://redwood.app/meetings/booking?slot=2027-03-22T10:00:00-07:00
